The '''Ansaline Gardens''' were a location in the [[Age of Legends]] where people could visit and relax. It appears to have been a substantial restaurant with an attached gambling area where games such as those involving ''[[chinje]]'' wheels could be played. Stylized sculptures of humans and animals by the famed artist [[Cormalinde Masoon]] were also displayed there. Only the finest food and drink was served at the Gardens.{{ref/book|c|Ansaline Gardens}}

The Gardens were a favorite haunt of many of the Age, including [[Balthamel]] and [[Graendal]] before and possibly after they turned to the [[Shadow]]. The Gardens were destroyed in the third year of the [[War of the Shadow]].

Graendal created a facsimile of the Gardens in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' for a meeting of the [[Forsaken]] in the spring of [[1000 NE]].
